title: TodoWrite
description: Write or update the agent's todo list. The list is shown in the TUI and is used to track progress on multi-step tasks. The full list is replaced on every call (not appended).

todos.description: The full todo list (replaces the existing list).

id.description: Stable ID for this todo. Re-use IDs to update existing todos; generate new IDs for new todos.

content.description: The todo content. One sentence, action-oriented (e.g. 'Add input validation to the login form').

status.description: Status of the todo. Only one todo should be 'in_progress' at a time.
